violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: In the walk in cooler observed Raw animal product. Foods of various origins ( beef, egg, pork, sausage) were being intermingled with RTE and Non-TCS vegetables.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC rearranged the Walk in Cooler following proper cross contamination instructions and poster.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Raw beef short ribs, chorizo sausage and precooked mussels on the counter of the three vat sink were being thawed in standing non flowing water. TCS food was not being thawed in either refrigeration or under cold running water
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC put item in the three vat sink sanitizer basin (unused side) and turned on running water to continue thawing TCS foods.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 4 drawer under counter cooler was observed at 52F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC agreed to call repair company and have the 4 drawer under counter cooler repaired TACO SSAM (Inspection Date: 07/31/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop faucet is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. PIC removed the backflow prevention devices from the mop sink faucet

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN STEAM TABLE: BEEF TONGUE AT 130F AND REFRIED BEANS AT 121F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BEEF TONGUE AND BEANS TAKEN TO STOVE TO REHEAT TO 165F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (5): RAW BEEF AT 46F (1HR), RAW PORK SAUSAGE AT 47F (1HR). OBSERVED IN (8): MILK AT 48F (1HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL FOOD TAKEN TO FREEZER TO RAPID COOL.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: OPENED AND UNSEALED COMMERCIALLY PREPARED KIMCHI OBSERVED OPENED AND UNSEALED COMMERCIALLY PREPARED KIMCHI DATED 08/12 IN WALK-IN COOLER. OWNER/PIC STATED UNAWARE OPENED KIMCHI WAS TCS FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI: KIMCHI REMOVED FROM PREMISES DURING INSPECTION. OWNER/PIC AWARE OPENED/UNSEALED KIMCHI CANNOT BE KEPT FOR LONGER THAN 6 DAYS.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED ICE SCOOP LEFT IN ICE MACHINE BEHIND BAR.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: ICE SCOOP REMOVED.

violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3): shrimp in ceviche
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: ceviche on the happy hour menu
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means.
